profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Siemens Healthineers

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - DevOps
positions.description:
Working in Software DevOps
Created and Managed CI Pipelines in Azure Devops.
Managed Azure Devops Server Source control.
Developed new installation process and software to reduce the installation time by 50% While improving reliability. 
Created intelligent scalable test infrastructure to handle large test sets that require different test environments. 
Worked with developers to improve code and tests.
Mentored junior developers.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Analyzed legacy software, Centricity Perinatal distributed system for various network
problem handing, presented solutions, and implemented the changes. Resulting in the
most stable version of the program.
Implemented data migration program using SQL server using hibernate and c#.
Developed HTML5 Mobile fetal monitoring web application to work on both the iPad and iPhone using responsive design.
Worked with the Software Testing group to implement automated testing using HP ALM software, using Quick Test Pro and BPT.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Automated and migrated C++ data migration process to Java, using Hibernate.
Designed and programmed the AMNews site subscriber LDAP registration program using Java, Hibernate, and Unix shell scripting.
Worked with Advantage Computing Systems fulfillment software.
Developed extensively using Eclipse.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Mobile Applications in Microsoft Embedded Visual C++ for Pocket PC devices.
Worked on windows versions of the mobile software in Visual C++ using MFC.
Created SQL scripts in Oracle and SQL Server to interface with the database for the mobile applications.
Created PL/SQL functions and procedures for Oracle and stored procedures for SQL Server 2000.
Optimized both SQL Server 2000 scripts and Oracle Scripts, and also resolved deadlock issues for both SQL Server and Oracle.
Created a daemon in Java to interface between SQL in Maximo application using and ClickSchedule XML interfaced software. Used Java to create XML messages for communicating to the ClickSchedule software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Programmed Windows 98/NT applications for visualizing and calibrating data obtained from Electronic Control Units in Visual C++ and Active X.
Programmed hand held monitoring devices for Windows CE environment using Visual C++ and also in Motorola 68HC11 assembly language.
Maintained and modified existing software that was written in Borland C++ and Borland C++ builder.
Created test fixtures to do automated testing of new electronic control units.
